advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard _locked_commit_phase against a truthy porcelain stdout that parses to an empty path list (treat as nothing-to-commit) so a dropped-token parse does not cause a spurious strict commit-failed.
evidence: src/rebar/_store/push.py:467: `staged = _git(  # raw-git-ok: locked store seam internal` then `"add", "--", *(f":(top){p}" for p in _porcelain_z_paths(dirty.stdout))`

_porcelain_z_paths skips any token with `len(token) < 4` (push.py:389) — if all tokens are dropped the generator yields nothing, so `git add --` stages nothing while `dirty.stdout` was truthy, and the subsequent commit-with-nothing-staged fails and (strict) raises.
advisory.finding: In _locked_commit_phase, when the scoped `git status --porcelain -z` returns non-empty stdout but _porcelain_z_paths parses out zero usable path tokens, `git add --` is invoked with no pathspec after `--` (adds nothing), then `git commit` runs with an empty index and fails with a non-zero returncode, which under strict=True raises PushDeliveryError — a spurious failure derived from a parse that silently dropped every token.
advisory.suggested_fix: After computing the parsed path list, if it is empty, return True (nothing to stage) rather than invoking `git add --` with no pathspec.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the source-grep in test_the_record_file_is_staged_for_commit_back with a behavioral test that drives a real tracker repo where only .bridge_state/impossible_links.json changed and asserts the file lands in HEAD (mirror test_binding_retired_commit.py / test_peer_confirmations_store.py).
evidence: The diff edits these very assertions (removing the old _tracked_basenames grep, adding the commit_tickets_branch/paths grep) rather than converting the test to drive a real tracker repo as its sibling tests in the same suite/dir were converted (test_peer_confirmations_store.py now uses subprocess git init + git show, test_binding_retired_commit.py drives real repos over the allowlist).
Rule 4 litmus: renaming the internal local `_existing_rel` to any other name in reconcile_helpers.py would fail this test while the commit behavior is unchanged.
advisory.finding: test_the_record_file_is_staged_for_commit_back asserts on the TEXT of the source under test (greps helpers.__file__ for 'commit_tickets_branch(' and 'paths=_existing_rel' and 'IMPOSSIBLE_LINKS_FILE'), making it a source-grepping change-detector that breaks on a behavior-preserving refactor (renaming _existing_rel, restructuring the staged-file list, or changing how the seam is invoked) with no observable behavior change.
scenarios: A refactor renames _existing_rel or extracts the staging list into a helper; behavior is identical but this test goes RED.
The seam call is reformatted (e.g. keyword order) such that the exact substring no longer matches.
advisory.suggested_fix: Delete the `source = Path(helpers.__file__).read_text(...)` block and its substring assertions; instead git-init a tracker repo, write only the impossible-links state file, call _commit_binding_store_snapshot, and assert `git show --name-only HEAD` contains that file (as test_binding_retired_commit.py::test_publication_stages_only_the_five_allowlisted_files already does behaviorally).
